## Summary

Child work item audit for Phased income animation (all phases, reduced motion) (CG-0MTDEAA2J001EFEF). 

All 10 ACs are MET. The phased income animation is implemented in `MainStreetAnimator.animateIncomePhases()` (line ~393) with five phases (base → synergy → reputation → events → upcoming) paced 2200ms apart, plus grid-to-HUD collection. Each phase has distinct coin animations (count-out, fly-in/out) with `COIN_POP` SFX via `moveGameObject()`. Event phase includes animated Upcoming-panel effect lines via `animateUpcomingEffectLine()` (one-letter reveal). Reduced motion runs phases on same schedule with text/phase labels only. Non-blocking via try/catch throughout. Replay/headless exemption returns immediately. Browser tests in `income-phase-animation.browser.test.ts` cover phase ordering, grid rendering, event lines, reduced motion, non-blocking, and replay exemption.

## Acceptance Criteria Status

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | Five phases execute in order: base → synergy → reputation → events → upcoming, each ~2–3s apart. | Met | `animateIncomePhases()`: `INCOME_PHASE_GAP_MS = 2200`. Phase meta array: base, synergy, reputation, events, upcoming, collect. Browser test verifies order: `['base','synergy','reputation','events','upcoming','collect']`. |
| 2 | Base phase: For each producing slot, base coins "count out" of the card into its on-card grid; SFX plays. | Met | `countOutCoins()`: delayed staggered `revealInGrid()` calls. `revealInGrid()`: `COIN_POP` SFX per coin. |
| 3 | Synergy phase: Synergy coins fly from the synergy line into affected card grids. | Met | `flyCoinsIn()` with sources from `synergyPhaseSources()` (midpoint of synergy pairs). `SFX_KEYS.COIN_POP` via `moveGameObject()`. |
| 4 | Reputation phase: Reputation coins fly from the reputation HUD counter into affected card grids. | Met | `flyCoinsIn()` with source at `s.layout.gameW * 0.5, s.layout.hudY`. |
| 5 | Event phase: Duration-effect events show animated text lines in the Upcoming panel (one-letter grow/shrink reveal); coins fly in/out to/from affected businesses. | Met | `eventDeltaEffects()` resolves effects. `animateUpcomingEffectLine()` in `MainStreetRenderer.ts:1506` — one-letter text reveal with scale overshoot. `flyCoinsIn()`/`flyCoinsOut()` for positive/negative deltas. |
| 6 | Upcoming phase: Upcoming cards affecting income fly coins in or out appropriately. | Met | `upcomingDeltas` iteration with `flyCoinsIn()` for positive, `flyCoinsOut()` for negative deltas. Placeholder data (not yet wired upstream) but mechanism is in place. |
| 7 | Grid-to-HUD collection: accumulated coins fly to HUD coins counter with "+total" pop and coin-pop SFX. | Met | `collectIncomeGrids()`: each icon flies to HUD counter (`coinX, hudY`). Final `+total` pop via `popTextOrIcon()` with `INCOME_POSITIVE` SFX. |
| 8 | Reduced motion: Same phases and pacing, but no coin flights or count-out tweens — text/phase progression only. | Met | `runIncomePhase()` checks `if (ctx.reducedMotion) return;` for each phase. Phase labels still shown. Collection final pop still plays (with reduced motion). |
| 9 | Non-blocking: Presentation-only; failures swallowed; never mutates game state, transcript, or turn flow. | Met | All phases wrapped in try/catch. `animateIncomePhases()` never mutates state. Browser test: "unknown slots skipped, no game state mutated". |
| 10 | Replay/headless exemption: No rendering or audio in replay/headless modes (documented). | Met | `if (s.replayMode) return;` at top of `animateIncomePhases()`. Browser test: `replayMode = true` → empty phase order, no state mutation. |
